items.title: Icons
items.description: YoRHa icon set: ChevronIcon, CheckIcon, CrossIcon, PlusIcon, MinusIcon, TriangleIcon, SortIcon, GripIcon, CalendarIcon, ClockIcon, EyeIcon, EyeOffIcon, SearchIcon. Sizes 12/16/20, viewBox equals render size, 2px square-cap strokes on whole pixels.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project. Inspired by the YoRHa UI aesthetic; no original fonts, logos or assets are included. Icons are decorative (aria-hidden); put them in a `grid place-items-center` box and label the control, not the icon.
